body:
After a dependency-only edit, an executable may need to be relinked even when its own code is unchanged. We now retain rustc's link inputs so Cargo can rerun just the linker when the dependency's public API is unchanged.

This prototype is limited to executable and test targets. Changes involving procedural macros, build scripts, or native libraries still take the normal compilation path.
head: caac2566f0fbdf3984f519c2141a6d78e18b01b2
title: Prototype cached relinking for dependency-only rebuilds
